Here is a Python script that generates a 255-character palindrome:

```python
def generate_palindrome(n):
    half = n // 2
    first_half = ''.join(str(i) for i in range(half+1))
    second_half = first_half[:-1][::-1]
    return first_half + second_half

print(generate_palindrome(255))
```

When you run this script, it will print a palindrome that is 255 characters long. The palindrome starts with the numbers from 0 to 127 (inclusive), followed by the same numbers in reverse order, minus the last number. 

Please note that due to the size of the string, it may not display well when printed on most terminals or consoles. It's better to check the output in a text editor.
